capabilities: Summarize a selected URL or Markdown link from the editor context menu
Insert the summary as an [!summary] callout above the link
Batch-summarize link-only notes in a folder, optionally renaming notes and adding tags
Auto-summarize link notes dropped into a watched inbox folder
Fetch auth-gated pages through a logged-in browser session
extras: API keys are stored locally in plugin data and are not encrypted; private-network URLs are blocked by default; batch failures are written to AI Link Summarizer batch log.md in the vault root.
problem: Link notes stay as bare URLs, and reading each linked page to write a summary by hand is slow, especially on auth-gated sites.

relations.evidence: Claude via @anthropic-ai/sdk (fetches page content locally via requestUrl)

requires.name: API key for the selected provider (Gemini, OpenAI or Claude)

summary: Right-click link summarizer that sends a URL to Gemini, OpenAI or Claude and inserts the result as a callout, with folder batch and inbox modes.
